# Human speech for AEC regression measurements

`librispeech-1688-142285-0007.f32le` is 32-bit little-endian float mono PCM,
16 kHz, from LibriSpeech test-other utterance 1688-142285-0007. Tests interpolate
it to 48 kHz in memory. It is never played on a device.

Source: https://download.pytorch.org/torchaudio/tutorial-assets/ctc-decoding/1688-142285-0007.wav
Official tutorial: https://docs.pytorch.org/audio/2.8/tutorials/asr_inference_with_ctc_decoder_tutorial.html

LibriSpeech was prepared by Vassil Panayotov with assistance from Daniel Povey,
from LibriVox audiobook recordings. License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Corpus/attribution:
https://www.openslr.org/12 . Change: WAV container removed, samples unchanged.
